filing_guidance.title: Delhi High Court filing preparation
filing_guidance.scope: High Court of Delhi e-filing preparation only. Case type, filing stage, jurisdiction and current registry directions still require advocate review.

requirements.title: High Court e-file size
requirements.detail: Maximum 300 MB. Above 300 MB, the notification directs the advocate or litigant to a Designated Centre for intranet e-filing.

requirements.title: Draft document format
requirements.detail: A4; Times New Roman 14; 1.5 line spacing; quotations and indents at 12 with single spacing; 4 cm left and right margins; 2 cm top and bottom.

requirements.title: Searchability and bookmarks
requirements.detail: The court-hosted FAQ says bookmarking is compulsory and recommends 300 DPI scanning with OCR. OCR output still requires visual and legal review.
requirements.source_label: Delhi High Court Online e-Filing FAQ

requirements.title: Party details
requirements.detail: The court-hosted FAQ says details of every petitioner and respondent are mandatory in the fresh-case workflow.
requirements.source_label: Delhi High Court Online e-Filing FAQ, Q18-Q19

templates.title: Memo of Parties upload template
templates.purpose: Court-provided spreadsheet for party data used by the e-filing facility.

templates.title: Urgent listing / accommodation form
templates.purpose: Official form for urgent mentioning cases; applicability and current process must be confirmed.

templates.title: Interlocutory applications form
templates.purpose: Official interlocutory-application form published on the Forms & Proformas page.

source_conflicts: The older FAQ states a 50 MB online limit. The later 2026 amendment substitutes Rule 3.4 and sets the High Court maximum e-file size at 300 MB.

The common-objections page contains older paper-format references, including foolscap. Do not use those references to override the later A4 Practice Directions without advocate and registry confirmation.
Common objections help prevent defects but are not a complete required-document checklist for every case type or filing stage.
